chunks: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice? Then they do not repent, nor do they take heed.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about failing to repent despite repeated trials?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the recurring trials (fitan) that serve as divine mercy to purify the faithful or expose the hypocrites (munafiqun), yet many remain heedless. The failure to repent or reflect indicates a hardening of the heart, where repeated exposure to adversity fails to trigger spiritual awakening or corrective action.
